facts.value: The manufacturer's ripple rating and its frequency derating are both fully specified on page 1 and are now recorded as first-class facts (fact-c2983319-ripple-120hz, fact-c2983319-ripple-freq-multiplier, fact-c2983319-ripple-hf-derate): 240 mA rms @120Hz/105C, x1.30 at 10kHz and above, giving 312 mA rms at the project's 150kHz switching frequency. This SUPERSEDES the earlier partial-extraction figures of approx. 1.0A @120Hz/85C and approx. 0.035 Ohm ESR, both of which were wrong -- the ripple by ~4x and the ESR by ~14x (see fact-c2983319-esr-120hz: tan-delta implies ~0.51 Ohm), each in the non-conservative direction, and the endurance temperature was misstated as 85C where the datasheet specifies 2000 h at 105C. What remains unverified is the INSTALLED ripple current at C3 (U2 +13.5V buck output filter) and C11 (U4 inverting buck-boost output filter, the higher-stress position) against that 312 mA rating; that is a bench measurement, tracked as BB-7.
facts.conditions: installed switching-frequency ripple current vs the manufacturer-derated rating

facts.value: RESOLVED: C11 sits on the -13.5V rail, C3 on the +13.5V rail. The generator spec is the source of truth for placement and states it unambiguously -- board_b_spec.py NETS puts C11.2 on '/DC-DC Conversion/-13.5V OUT' (beside U4.3/U4.5/U4.6, D3.2, C9.2, C24.2, U8.2) with C11.1 on GND, and C3.1 on '/DC-DC Conversion/+13.5V OUT' with C3.2 on GND. That agrees with the three independent reads BB-12 already had (board-b-synth-power.md's U4 net table, the locked baseline's -13.5V OUT row, and the sheet-geometry adjacency probe). inventory.json's line-level function text was the sole outlier and has been corrected to describe both refdes. This fact records the resolution; it no longer blocks. Note this does NOT settle pin-1/pin-2 polarity, which remains UNCONFIRMED in the pin map.
facts.conditions: cross-source discrepancy, resolved against the generator spec

facts.value: CANONICAL PICK: C335982 (ROQANG RVT1A471M0607, 10V) should become the canonical LCSC number for the physical part actually drawn at C4/C22/C23 once a future wave applies this decision to the schgen spec; C22383803 (ACMECON RVT1C471M0607, 16V) is recorded as the alias. Rationale, dated 2026-08-14: (1) orderability -- C335982 shows ~368,560-490,460 units in stock at LCSC vs. ~3,790 units for C22383803, a two-orders-of-magnitude difference; (2) design-intent match -- C335982's 10V rating matches the Value field ('470uF 10V') already on every C4/C22/C23 instance and the project's #93-fixed documentation, while C22383803 is actually a 16V-rated part per its current LCSC listing (this corrects the issue-117 assumption that both listings are 10V); (3) drawn-symbol match -- the schematic's actually-placed symbol is 'RVT1A471M0607_C335982', not the ACMECON part. The 'LCSC Part'/'Datasheet' schematic properties pointing at C22383803 (fact-c22383803-schematic-lcsc-field) are treated as a pre-existing documentation mismatch this bundle surfaces but does not fix.

facts.value: RESIZED, not yet measured. spec-architecture-review.md computes output-cap RMS ripple ~0.77 A at the 0.8 A rated load on '/DC-DC Conversion/-13.5V OUT'. With the as-built two-can bank (C11 || C24) an ESR-ratio split put C11 at ~362 mA against its 312 mA rating (~1.16x over) and C24 at ~408 mA against 403 mA (~1.01x) -- both at or over rating. Decision neg-rail-cap-bank adds C12 (a second C22387780) in parallel; the three-can split is now C11 ~237 mA = 75.9% of 312 mA and C24 = C12 ~267 mA = 66.1% of 403 mA (fact-c2983319-c11-ripple-share-3can, fact-c22387780-can-ripple-share-3can), so every can sits inside the 85% sizing bar. Caveat unchanged: the split uses 120Hz ESR because neither datasheet publishes ESR at 150kHz; aluminium-electrolytic ESR falls and flattens with frequency, so the absolute values are pessimistic while the RATIO between two same-technology, similar-size cans is the trustworthy part. NEEDS BENCH remains: the installed ripple at C11/C24/C12 is still unmeasured. Tracked as issue #155 and BB-7.
